brand.name: Rise & Shine
brand.tagline: The daily signal for people building what's next.
brand.type: Social Media Intelligence / Editorial Media Brand
coverage: Global developments relevant to Indian builders
Research, tools, reports, and ideas worth knowing
Important news that can affect founders and builders
audience: Followers of India's startup and technology ecosystem
brand.geography: India-first; global developments covered when relevant to Indian builders

philosophy.name: Signal Over Noise
philosophy.statement: Someone already did the filtering for me.
questions: What should a builder understand from it?

keilHQRelationship.keilHQ: Human Clarity — turns Context → Decisions → Work. A quiet room for thinking.
keilHQRelationship.ras: Information Clarity — turns Information → Signal → Understanding → Action. The morning signal that starts the day.
rasDifference: More culturally connected to the internet

visualConcept.name: Ink. Paper. Daybreak.
visualConcept.paper: Editorial credibility, reading, clarity, context, human communication
visualConcept.daybreak: Optimism, discovery, new ideas, opportunity, progress, the future

signature.name: Daybreak Vermilion
signature.role: Primary RAS signature colour — a signal, not a default
signature.rule: Do not cover every design in orange. Vermilion should feel like a signal.

accents.name: Fresh Lime
accents.role: Emergence accent — use sparingly, never as a primary

hierarchy.note: Guidelines, not strict rules. Hierarchy matters more than exact ratios.

colors.coreCombination: Midnight Ink + Daybreak Paper + Daybreak Vermilion — the most recognisable RAS combination.

do: Use Vermilion as the recognisable RAS signal
Use accent colours to highlight important information
dont: Use every accent colour in one composition
Let accent colours compete with the headline
Introduce random colours without adding them to the brand system

primary.rendererFallbackNote: Satoshi is not openly licensed for vendoring; the Satori renderer substitutes Inter (same grotesque class, matched weights) via fontFamily: Inter. Set display/headline weights explicitly (700/800).

editorial.example: THE AI RACE / is already moving.

principles: Large — headlines may dominate the composition
Tight — display type uses compact line-height
Hierarchical — size and weight before additional colours
Editorial — composed, not a software dashboard

logos.concept: Custom geometric RAS wordmark; the central A incorporates a rising sunrise (Rise + Horizon + Daybreak). Standalone symbol = Geometric Rising-A + Sunrise.
logos.sunriseNote: Sampled from production assets: warm sunrise gradient from gold (#FDA635) through Daybreak Vermilion (#F25C3D) to deep orange (#FB5104), nested in the A's counter.

files.artwork: Midnight Ink RAS wordmark + sunrise + by KeilHQ
Warm-white RAS wordmark + sunrise + by KeilHQ

lockups.full: RAS / RISE & SHINE / by KeilHQ — brand pages, launch material, presentations, website, brand announcements
lockups.wordmark: RAS — social posts, headers, video intros, watermarks, editorial graphics
lockups.symbol: Geometric A + Sunrise — profile pictures, favicons, small placements, watermarks, app-style icons

do: Use the standalone symbol at small sizes
dont: Add glow to the full wordmark
Add random gradients to the letterforms
Place the logo on noisy imagery without a clear container

layout.aesthetic: Premium editorial publication × modern internet × technology culture — contemporary, never generic-AI-startup
layout.typographyAsGraphics: Typography may be the main visual element (e.g. 3 THINGS FOUNDERS NEED TO KNOW).
layout.avoidDashboard: Structure without feeling like an enterprise dashboard.

do: Lead every story with Signal + Context + Relevance
Answer: what happened, why it matters, who should care
Keep the Ink + Paper + Vermilion combination recognisable
Let headlines dominate; hierarchy via size and weight
Use the correct logo variant for the background
dont: Behave like a generic news aggregator or PR channel
Publish hype, clickbait, or motivational filler
Mix category worlds in one composition
Use purple/cyan AI gradients, glassmorphism, or neon clichés
Set dense body copy in Instrument Serif
Alter the logo geometry or sunrise colour

renderer.themeSuggestion: New designs should add a ras theme mapping these tokens (paper background, ink foreground, vermilion signal, per-category accent).
renderer.logoUsage: Inline the transparent PNGs via loadImage() with explicit width/height; pick light/dark variant by background.

metadata.source: Rise & Shine (RAS) — Brand Guidelines by KeilHQ
